voices.note: the etrog mishnah (34b.9), whose small-etrog dispute is the lemma at 36b.6
the דתניא Rafram invokes at 36b.6: three rounded stones on Shabbat

props.gloss_en: R' Meir: the minimum size of an etrog is a nut
R' Yehuda: the minimum size of an etrog is an egg
Rafram bar Pappa: as the dispute here, so is the dispute over rounded stones
on Shabbat, three rounded stones may be brought into the privy
and how much is their measure? R' Meir: a nut
